text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...Incredible. All three of them got faster again.
No... not just the three of them.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Those two are too.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, —me too. Not yet. I need more.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hahh... hahh... hahh...!! More—!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
More, more! Even more!!
Don't stop!! Squeeze out every drop!! —...Keep going!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Pwah?! Hehh, hahh... Wah. 3:00 AM again...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh, but that's perfect! I can put this early start to good use!
I didn't get to train yesterday either, so...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Lady Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Bright-san?!
I'm so sorry, did I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is quite all right.
We simply awoke because we wished to be awake, you see.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, Bright-san? What do you mean, 'we'...?

The smartphone resting on the desk begins to vibrate.
I pick it up and gently press the answer button.
choice_data_list: Hello? Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: 『Trainer?!』

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: No way!! H-How? Bright-sa... Aaahhh...
choice_data_list: 『Were you awake at this hour the other day too?』
『Were you awake at this hour the other day too?』

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eep?! Uh, well...
choice_data_list: 『...Could you not sleep that day either?』

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—!
...That is, well, um...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A-At first, it just kinda happened. My body's frailer than most.
I don't have much stamina. I'm bad at sleeping. So I started waking up weirdly early...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
B-But I'm sorry! I know! I understand!
I shouldn't push myself if I'm not feeling well. Especially since my body's weak!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even when working hard, sometimes you have to take a break...
But... even so—...
choice_data_list: 『You know all that, and yet you still want to give it everything you've got.』
『You know all that, and yet you still want to give it everything you've got.』

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: 『I figured you'd say that.』
"I knew you'd say that."

text_block_list.text:
I lay out my reference materials while unfolding the letter Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi handed me.
...It's been a while since I've read nutrition textbooks so thoroughly.
choice_data_list: ...I feel the same way. I want to give it my all with you.
...I feel the same way. I want to give it my all with you.

text_block_list.text:
"Operation Tsuyoshi Eats 10 Bowls of Ramen!"—that was Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's proposal.
Her enthusiasm is admirable, but... the plan has far too many holes.
choice_data_list: So I decided to send her some revisions.
So I'm going to send you some revisions.

text_block_list.text: (*Ping*)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Revisions...? Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. When on earth did you put all this together?
Everything from tips on how to eat noodles to stretches for digestion...!
choice_data_list: "If you're going to put in effort, put it in the right way."

text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi has yet to make her debut.
Up until now, she's never had a personal trainer dedicated to her.

And with all the time she's had to take off, she's naturally spent a lot of time studying on her own.
All without ever having many chances to be taught *what* she should be studying.
choice_data_list: (Even so, you kept pushing forward alone on a road you couldn't see the end of...)

text_block_list.text:
Without any direction, she just gathered as much information as she could
and put in every ounce of effort possible. Frantically running forward all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...I just didn't want to stop.
Even if I was doing it wrong... I just wanted to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Just like everyone else is moving forward—I wanted to get closer to my goal, too.
choice_data_list: I know. That's why I'll light the path for you.
I know. That's why I'll light the path for you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Do that, and I'm sure it won't be scary anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...You saw right through me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, my body is weak. I have to take breaks every now and then.
I'm the kind of person who ends up a lap behind.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I don't want to give up on trying hard. I don't want to stop.
If you can teach me the right way to put in the work, that's how I want to move forward.
choice_data_list: "Yeah. And I'll stay right by your side all the way to the end."
"Yeah. And I'll stay right by your side all the way to the end."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh—?!

...I have no intention of running from that responsibility. I am about to guide a fragile girl
down a thorny path where her racing career is sure to be grueling.
choice_data_list: No matter what happens, I'll always be there to support you.
No matter what happens, I'll always be there to support you.

text_block_list.text:
—I'm fully prepared for this. As someone who pointed her down this road, I'll see it through to the end.
Even when we both step away from racing. I will be someone she can always lean on.
choice_data_list: Whenever you're in trouble, I'll always come to help.
Whenever you're in trouble, I'll always come to help.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —...I have you with me.
choice_data_list: "So go wherever your heart leads you! Tsuyoshi!!"
"So go wherever your heart leads you! Tsuyoshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...—Ngh, YES!!
I'll give it everything I've got!! So—!
choice_data_list: "Let's keep going all out from here on, too!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Right on!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"So Trainer! I really want to try out training in a lazy river pool next.
It puts way less strain on the body, after all!"
choice_data_list: Oh, you've got quite a few plans lined up yourself, Tsuyoshi.
Oh, you've got quite a few plans lined up yourself, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Yep! I have a lot more time to think than the other girls do!
I've come up with tons of other ideas too, like... *yaaawn*...—"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"S-Sorry. Ehehe...
I guess talking about all this just made me feel so... heheh..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Umm, Twayner... I'm gonna... do my besht...—"
choice_data_list: ...? Tsuyoshi? Hellooo?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, dear.
Dear Tsu-chan is fast asleep~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sound asleep.
I suspect she won't wake up until morning...
choice_data_list: "..I see."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah, ah, aahh!! Trainer!!
!! I'm so sorry about today—
choice_data_list: Hey there, Tsuyoshi! Heard you overslept today!
Hey there, Tsuyoshi! Heard you overslept today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Bwah?! H-H-H-How did you find out...?! 
Was it Bright-san?! Or El-chan and the others?!
choice_data_list: Now, now. More importantly, how are you feeling today?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Today...? 
...Well, let's see.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My body feels lighter than it has in days!
If I run like this, I know I can clock a great time.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...So, Trainer. If I do super well in today's training
and show you a run that really gets your hopes up—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Would you officially sign a contract with me today?
...To make me the horsegirl you train.

The schedule for today was set. Heading out to the track with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
She took her position, caught her breath, and sharpened her focus—
choice_data_list: Go for it, Tsuyoshi!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Right!!

Seeing her run in person at long last was truly magnificent.
It filled me with genuine hope.

—The moment she finished running, we signed our trainer contract,
vowing together to aim for the Triple Crown.
